BiblicalUsage: Scripture uses theosébeia where it means godliness, devoutness. In 1 Timothy 2:10, (which becometh women professing godliness) with good works.
TheologicalSignificance: Good works worn as the mark of godliness make me check whether my own profession of faith shows up in how I live.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
